understanding: Le dispositif utilise un signal infrarouge pour créer un champ de détection autour de lui.

candidates.action: Red streams emanate from the sensor and create a visible dome-shaped field in front of it.
candidates.explains: Demonstrates how the infrared signal extends outward to cover an area.
candidates.misses: Doesn't show that the field adjusts or responds to movement.

candidates.action: Multiple red streams pulse outward from the sensor in waves, reaching a distant imaginary boundary.
candidates.explains: Shows the infrared signal traveling outward and delineating the coverage area.
candidates.misses: Does not visually connect the coverage field to detection capability.

candidates.action: Red streams hit an imaginary object or surface and bounce back to the sensor.
candidates.explains: Indicates that the infrared signal is used to detect objects in its range.
candidates.misses: Fails to depict the creation of a continuous detection field.

chosen: Red streams emanate from the sensor and create a visible dome-shaped field in front of it.
why_chosen: This action clearly visualizes the formation of a detection field around the sensor, making it evident that the infrared signal spreads to cover an area without relying on dynamic changes that may distract or complicate understanding.
